subject.title: fix(sqlite): prevent snapshot WAL growth under writes

question: Should the SQLite snapshot owner approve this online-backup design after its full concurrency and restore contract has been reviewed?
rationale: The patch changes a persistence-critical backup boundary, and the required repository and dependency inspection could not be completed in the available sandbox.

options.title: Complete owner review
options.body: Review the full snapshot, backup, restore, and Node SQLite backup contracts before deciding whether this change is safe to merge.

options.title: Pause for targeted proof
options.body: Request a redacted live-write reproduction that demonstrates WAL reuse and a successful restore from the produced single-file snapshot.

recommendation.title: Complete owner review
recommendation.body: Review the full snapshot, backup, restore, and Node SQLite backup contracts before deciding whether this change is safe to merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied context shows ownership of the active snapshot reliability work, but repository history could not be inspected.
